resources.string: Manage a separate key for each provider. Keys are encrypted on this device and sent only to the selected provider. Checking a key does not confirm model access or quota.
Input is cleared when submitted. Save checks the current key again and saves only a verified key. Re-enter the key to retry.
Delete the %1$s key from this device? Future requests will require a new key. This does not revoke the key with the provider.
Key deleted. Provider is no longer configured.
Secure storage is unavailable. No saved key is displayed. Retry when the device is ready.
Stored key cannot be decrypted. It has not been replaced. Delete it explicitly, then enter a new key.
Enter a non-empty key without spaces or line breaks.
The operation could not be completed. Retry.
VALID — authentication accepted. Model access and quota can still be restricted. Nothing was saved by this check.
INVALID — the provider rejected authentication. The saved key has not changed.
UNVERIFIED — access is restricted (403). This does not prove the key is invalid. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — rate limit reached. Retry later. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — provider temporarily unavailable. Retry later. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — network unavailable. Check your connection. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — request timed out. Retry. Nothing was saved.
UNVERIFIED — authentication could not be confirmed. Nothing was saved.
